_readme: Maps each session channel to an external audio file (e.g. Google Drive) for MANUAL seeking.
The viewer does NOT stream audio; for each chunk it shows 'chNN @ mm:ss' and, if a url is set,
an external link. The timestamp is the offset to seek to inside that channel's file (play.start).
Fill `url` with a shareable link AFTER you upload the per-channel .opus. Leave url empty ('') to
show the timestamp only. If you split a channel into parts, add more segments with start/end
(seconds, transcript-channel concat clock); the viewer picks the segment covering the timestamp
and shows the offset within that part. `end: null` means open-ended (last/only part).
